prompts.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create ONE production-quality visual reference for the MAIN MENU of the existing landscape 3D pet game CAT HOME, 16:9, ideally 3840x2160, razor-sharp readable UI.
Input image 1 is the EXISTING GAME SCREEN: preserve the exact three faceted low-poly cats and the existing furniture identities (cream/gold furniture, coral upholstery, mint rug, golden floor lamp, aqua plant). Input image 2 is an additional identity reference showing the game's ten cat breeds. Preserve their modest realistic cat eyes, angular mesh shapes, body proportions and colors. Do NOT replace them with fluffy giant-eyed kittens or newly invented mascot art. These game assets are the source of truth.
Redesign the interface thoroughly, modern premium cozy game art direction. NOT a screenshot of the current UI. Exact game cats should be the visual heroes, clearly visible with refined warm lighting, contact shadows and clean antialiasing. Main composition: tasteful cream airy title region on left 34%, cats in their cozy existing interior across middle and right 66%. A smaller confident CAT HOME wordmark top-left, warm rounded Fredoka-like dark ink typography. Beneath it, quiet tiny text 'LOKİŞ SENİ BEKLİYOR', large friendly heading 'Yuvana hoş geldin.' and one short supporting line 'Birlikte güzel bir gün daha.' One dominant coral button 'DEVAM ET' with small right arrow, subtle upper highlight and crafted inner depth, no outer neon glow, no nested rainbow rims. Beneath this only subtle secondary text action 'Yeni oyun'. Low on left a quiet compact line 'Yuva seviyesi 30'. Small understated round settings icon top-right. Across bottom-right place THREE restrained compact navigation tiles 'Kedim', 'Odalar', 'Oyunlar', with small polished consistent icons, one slim translucent cream surface each. No giant thumbnail towers or competing purchase CTAs. Generous margins of 64px minimum at fullHD equivalent, balanced negative space, no overlaps, no phone bezel, no presentation-board border.
Color palette warm ivory #FFF9EF, mint #DDEDE3, turquoise #218F87, coral #F5786C, ink #293A3B; pale lilac/gold only tiny accent. Delicate gradients and fine inner highlights only. Crisp dark legible text, no all-caps paragraphs. Actual Turkish letters accurately rendered. No fake discounts, no developer labels, no debug information. Show ONLY the complete finished 16:9 interface screenshot. This is a visual design reference, not a new game or new assets.

Three modest horizontal cream need capsules near upper center, dark ink labels 'Tokluk 78%', 'Su 92%', 'Enerji 65%', discreet colored progress strips, miniature bowl/drop/moon icons. Bottom-center a restrained ivory floating dock with three separated actions: 'MAĞAZA', a smaller 'Salon  •  4/10' room selector with chevron, 'OYUNLAR'. Primary navigation is easy to recognize. Tiny notifications at most one dot, no particle confetti or blinking UI.
Match input2 warm ivory #FFF9EF, mint #DDEDE3, turquoise #218F87, coral #F5786C, very dark ink #293A3B. Rounded friendly professional type, subtle fine inner highlight, single fine rims, gentle dimensional controls. No multi-ring frames, neon, opaque full-width HUD bar, huge panels, extraneous marketing phrases. Keep 48px equivalent margins, no control overlaps, no clipped labels, no device frame. All Turkish text exact and legible. Show just the redesigned screen.

Currency artwork: embossed pink paw on a polished gold coin and layered cyan-blue faceted diamond, never plain letter currency symbols. The dark blue background in product input images is NOT part of the furniture, do not bring those rectangles into the new cards.
The complete game screen is a large airy warm ivory store surface, with the cozy game interior subtly visible and defocused at the far outer edge. Top row: small tasteful shopping bag mark, heading 'Mağaza', quiet subtitle 'Küçük dokunuşlar, mutlu bir yuva.'; top-right separate modest balance pills 657 coin and 20 diamonds and a compact circular X. Next row has small 'Salon' room selector on left and compact 'Koleksiyon  4/10' progress on right.
The MAIN AREA fills most of the screen: FOUR generously sized product cards in a single clean horizontal row, with MUCH LARGER product images occupying the upper two thirds of each card. Four cards left to right are 'Lambader' (500 gold coin and 5 blue diamond), 'Berjer' (700 and 7), 'Salon bitkisi' (900 and 9), 'Kitaplık' (1100 and 11). Both price icons visible separately, do not use currency letters. Some cards may have small category labels 'Işık', 'Dinlenme', 'Dekor', 'Kitap köşesi' but no long paragraphs. A slender visible vertical scroll indicator on far right. Lower edge contains one understated information line with a tiny room pin 'Aldığın eşya, odadaki hazır yerine eklenir.' Modern craftsmanship, fine inner highlight, very restrained soft depth, 24px-equivalent gaps and substantial margins. Cards should be calm gallery-like display surfaces, not glossy stacked rainbow buttons. Dark readable labels; no giant banners, giant ribbons, excessive sparkles, fake sales or TEST/FREE text. All text Turkish accurate, no overlap, no phone mockup, only the full finished screen.
